本回答引用：全文片段。

## 核心判断

- 训练时，pixelSplat在近远平面间把深度离散成多个桶，输出每个桶存在表面的离散概率分布，由该分布参数化地表示高斯可能存在的深度位置，从而端到端训练整个模型。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_979bc4a941c61d0a9071e6859481500635b251277259a6864a79ef3bc647d819)

findings: External v4 fulltext is actually acquired; method page 5 is selected and a literal depth-bucket quotation is published.
Initial motivation invents monocular uncertainty/multiple surfaces as author-stated causes without the cited support; rejected.
Repair narrows the training claim to depth buckets, omitting the opacity/probability gradient coupling required by the frozen question.
Only one literal quotation survives extraction; source excerpts with PDF line-wrap hyphens were not recovered by the old strict matcher.
The final report is honestly marked partial and retains two open requirements. It is not an accepted novice explanation.
Live UI shows the v4 arXiv source link and physical page 5, but this citation modal still offers only the external source page, not the required controlled in-app fulltext reader.
